incident-bot: Pager: Hosted API p99 text-gen latency > 18s in us-east-1, queued requests 12k and rising. Auto-remediation attempted (autoscaler) but scale_up returned quota_rejected.

Alice (oncall): ACK — I'm on it, pulling up the per-model queue dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/hosted/queue/us-east-1

Ben (infra): seeing a flurry of provisioner 429s around 1714808800-1714808900. Autoscaler requested 80 GPUs; cloud RPC returned quota_exceeded / soft-limit. Logs: `provisioner: scale_up -> error=QuotaExceeded(code=403)`

Carla (sre): GPU pools are at 100% pinned. Eviction rate spiked; KV cache cold for many requests (cache_hit ~5%). This looks like an influx of long-context generation traffic from a marketing campaign.

Dave (ops): manual create of replacement instances failing on provider side — hit account-level quota. Opening cloud support, but ETA unknown. Filing provider ticket INC-7232.

Eve (support): support queue lighting up — several customers reporting 504s and slow completions, primarily the ones hitting long-context endpoints. I flagged highest- SLA customers and started outbound ops messages.

Alice (oncall): Mitigation plan (short term): 1) Enable fallback routing for non-enterprise orgs to `rwd-small-quant` model; 2) Apply soft rate limits for per-org rps > baseline; 3) Enable prefix caching where possible; 4) Reduce default max_tokens to 512 for hosted route until stabilized.

Ben (infra): I can flip the fallback flag now. Command: ```
# enable fc fallback routing for hosted API
curl -X POST https://control.redwood.ai/flags/fallback-route \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"enabled":true, "target_model":"rwd-small-quant", "filter":"!enterprise"}'
```

Ben (infra): Done. Fallback is active; routing logs show ~6k requests now redirected to `rwd-small-quant`. Latency for those dropped to p95~120ms.

Carla (sre): Applying per-org throttles for top offenders: ```
# ephemeral throttle rules
POST /v1/ops/throttles
{ "orgs": ["org-123","org-789"], "rps": 30 }
```

Carla (sre): Throttles applied. Queue growth rate halved within 90s. p95 for hosted text-gen dropped from 7.2s -> 1.4s for non-throttled traffic.

Dave (ops): Cloud ticket updated: requesting quota bump + temporary ephemeral pool. Provider asked for justification; I supplied incident metrics and requested +100 GPUs for 2 hours. No firm ETA yet.

Eve (support): Sent initial customer comms to impacted accounts with workaround instructions (use shorter contexts, retry backoffs). Will post status update in status.redwood.ai: #incident-1714809000.

Ben (infra): One issue: autoscaler code treats fallback routing as capacity-neutral; we saw routing redirects but autoscaler still tried to provision full capacity for primary models. Need quick patch to include fallback reductions in requested capacity calc. Pushing hotfix to staging now.

Alice (oncall): Hotfix deployed to staging; rolling to prod as patch. If autoscaler respects fallback I expect provisioning demand to fall significantly and cloud quota won't be hit as badly.

Carla (sre): Observability note: add a dashboard row for `fallback_routed_count` and `autoscaler_request_reason` to make this visible next time.

Ben (infra): Autoscaler patch rolled; new behavior subtracts fallback-routed QPS from scale target. Observed reduction in scale_up requests. Provisioner queue now stable.

Alice (oncall): Summary: fallback routing + per-org throttles + reduced defaults stabilized queues. Customer impact: ~420 orgs saw elevated latency/errors, ~18 enterprise customers experienced degraded responses with support notices. No data loss.

Dave (ops): Handoff — I'm staying on cloud ticket and provider comms. Ben, please take on-call for next 2 hours to watch autoscaler metrics; Carla you'll handle SRE/observability follow-ups; Eve continue customer comms. I'm logging tasks in the incident board. :thumbsup:

Ben (infra): Taking handoff. I’ll keep an eye on `provisioner.*` and `autoscaler.*` metrics, and follow up on the quota bump.

Alice (oncall): Thanks everyone — I'll draft an incident timeline and assign a postmortem owner. Preliminary RCA pointers: sudden customer campaign traffic, autoscaler not accounting for fallback routing, cloud provider quota friction.

Eve (support): Noted. I'll consolidate impacted customer list and attach sample request ids.

incident-bot: Incident escalated -> major incident. Postmortem scheduled: 1714818000 (TZ aware).

Carla (sre): Leaving notes for postmortem: - improve autoscaler visibility for routed fallbacks - add emergency throttle runbook - pre-authorize ephemeral burst quota path with provider

Alice (oncall): Handoff complete. Closing on-call for me. Ben, ping me if anything regresses. :wave:
